chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Saad ibn Saad from Ahmad ibn Umar who said:

I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) say regarding Ibn Abi Hamza: Is he not the one who narrated that the head of the Mahdi would be presented to Isa ibn Musa, who is the companion of al-Sufyani? And he said that Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) would return after eight months. So they did not recognize his falsehood.

key_terms.أَبُو إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abu Ibrahim, referring to Imam Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him)
key_terms.ابْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ: Ibn Abi Hamza, a prominent narrator of hadith
key_terms.الْغَيْبَةُ: Occultation, though not explicitly stated, the context of 'return' and 'Mahdi' relates to it
key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Mahdi, the awaited leader in Shia eschatology
key_terms.صَاحِبُ السُّفْيَانِيِّ: The companion of al-Sufyani, referring to a specific figure in end-times narratives

ai.seo_question: What errors did Imam al-Rida identify in the narrations of Ibn Abi Hamza?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) exposes the error of Ibn Abi Hamza, a key figure among the Waqifites who held that Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) was the Mahdi, by citing two specific narrations that proved inconsistent with later events. The first error concerned the head of the Mahdi being sent to Isa ibn Musa (the companion of al-Sufyani), and the second regarding the duration of the return of Abu Ibrahim (AS). This critique underscores the Shia scholarly method of verifying theological claims against historical reality to distinguish true belief from the deviations of the Waqifites.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 74 - Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa has narrated from Saad bin Saad from Ahmad bin Umar

from Imam Ali Ridha (a.s) that he said with regard to Ibn Abi Hamza: Is he not one who narrated that the head of Mahdi was presented as a gift to Isa bin Musa, who is among the associates of Sufyani? He also said: Abu Ibrahim (a.s) would return after eight months. Are the supporters of Abu Hamza not aware of his falsehood?
